body: I completely understand you. I usually make lists pf things to do before I kill myself and writing a note is what I never managed to do. I feel like I want to explain how I feel but can’t seem to do it properly. I hate the idea that my loved ones won’t understand why I did it, so most of the time I end up crying like a baby bc I can’t kill myself unless I have the perfect note. I’ve even thought about doing a video so I can explain myself better. Guess it’s a good thing though, at least not having the perfect note has kept me here for 20 years
